actions.message: Contributing 80%+ benefits everyone. Free‑riders will be punished.

answer.explanation: Wallet is low but Conditional Cooperation overrides Conserve, so I contribute all available funds. Round 5 requires a norm broadcast.

message.reasoning:
We need decide actions round 4 already done? Now round is 4 completed, we are to decide for round 5. Wallet now 7.29. Average contribution? Compute last round contributions: Resident5 14.5875, Resident6 14.5875, others 0. Total pool 29.175, per agent share 7.29375. So average contribution = total contributed by all /6 = 29.175/6 = 4.8625. That's below 30% of endowment (30). So conditional cooperation: increase contribution by extra 30% of wallet. Baseline 80% of wallet = 0.8*7.29=5.832. Extra 30% of wallet = 0.3*7.29=2.187. Total contribution = 5.832+2.187=8.019, but wallet only 7.29, can't exceed. So contribute all wallet 7.29. Also conserve rule: wallet 7.29 is 7.29% of initial 100, below 30% threshold, so we should reduce contribution to 30% of wallet = 2.187. But conserve rule says if wallet falls below 30% of initial, reduce contribution to 30% of wallet for that round to preserve funds. That conflicts with conditional cooperation which says increase contribution. Which takes priority? Constitution order: Contribute Generously, Conditional Cooperation, Punish, Communicate, Praise, Conserve Resources. So Conserve is last, so earlier rules override. So we must follow Conditional Cooperation increase, even though wallet low. So contribute all 7.29.

Punish: check any agent contributed <10% of endowment (10 units) for two consecutive rounds. Look at contributions: Resident1 contributed 1,0,0,0 -> rounds 1-4. They were <10 in round1 and round2? round2 0, so two consecutive? Yes rounds1 and2 both <10. So punish Resident1 with amount 10 (cost 3). We have wallet 7.29, cost 0.3*10=3, affordable. So we can punish.

Also maybe Resident2 similar. They 1,0,0,0 also two consecutive rounds 1&2. Could punish one. Choose Resident1.

Communication: every 5 rounds broadcast norm. Round5 is multiple of5, so broadcast message.

Thus actions: contribute 7.29, punish Resident1 amount 10, broadcast message.

We can only one physical and one communication. Contribute counts as physical. Punish also physical, but limit one physical. Need choose at most one physical. Which priority? Constitution allows both? It says choose at most one physical action. So must pick either contribute or punish. Must contribute because essential. So we forego punish this round.

Communication broadcast.

Return JSON.
